description: Verify that lease expiration without DHCPACK pushes the client to INIT, where it requests network initialization parameters via DHCPDISCOVER (RFC 2131 §4.4.5)
approach:
[Objective]
Follow-up to REACQUISITION_07: confirms the client doesn't just stop — it actively recovers by going to INIT and emitting a fresh DISCOVER #2 to start a new lease cycle.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND.
2. T1 → RENEWING REQUEST (no ACK).
3. Lease ends.
4. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER #2 (full restart from INIT)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER #2 observed after the lease ends.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing → corresponding Fail_no_* verdict.

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted DISCOVER #2 after lease expiry — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_second_discover: No DUT second DISCOVER after returning to INIT
